identity.name: FamFocus Hub
identity.description: A dark-mode first family management dashboard that balances data density with friendly, accessible UI for all ages.

headings.usage: Use for all page titles, card headers, and major stats. Tight tracking (-0.025em).

body.usage: Use for all standard text, lists, and inputs. Excellent legibility at small sizes.

mono.usage: Use sparingly for IDs, codes, or debug info.

dashboard_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6 p-4 md:p-6

mobile_navigation.description: Replace floating pill with a fixed bottom glass dock for better accessibility and z-index management.

sidebar.state_collapsed: Width: w-20. Must use Tooltip/Popover for labels. Icons must be centered.
sidebar.mobile: Sheet/Drawer component triggered by hamburger menu.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 transition-all hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-[0.98]

cards.base: glass-card rounded-2xl p-6 transition-all duration-300 hover:border-white/20

inputs.base: bg-slate-950/50 border-white/10 focus:border-primary/50 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-xl

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. THEME: Enforce 'dark' class on the root element. Ensure 'bg-slate-950' is the global background.

2. SIDEBAR FIX: The collapsed sidebar dropdowns are likely failing due to 'overflow-hidden' on the container or z-index issues. Use Radix UI 'Portal' or ensure the dropdown menu has a higher z-index and is not clipped by the sidebar container.
3. MOBILE NAV: Implement a fixed bottom navigation bar (Glass Dock) for mobile screens (< md). Hide the sidebar on mobile.
4. POLISH: Replace standard borders with 'border-white/10'. Add subtle 'hover:bg-white/5' to interactive list items.
5. FONTS: Ensure 'Outfit' is used for all headings and 'Manrope' for body text.
6. DATA-TESTID: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links).
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
